statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has a diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was billed
The diagnosis code G45.9 (transient ischemic attack) was submitted
The diagnosis code R00.2 (palpitations) was submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The monitor is ordered to evaluate for potential embolic sources related to transient ischemic attacks
The monitor is ordered to identify underlying arrhythmia associated with sick sinus syndrome
